title: 第7章 陛下何故造反第8章 八姐沈慕戎
slug: 大婚之日我阉了未婚妻的白月光
content_zh:
此话一出！
全场皆惊！
哪怕是林百川刚刚坐稳，也忍不住噌的一声站起来：“叶凡，你……”
叶凡冷笑：“今日陛下八十龙寿！”
“区区一个东江王世子，居然敢当众质问大夏皇帝亲自敕封的一字并肩镇北王！”
“你林家不是想造反？”
林霄的脸色惨白到极致！
林百川的一张老脸，更是铁青，咬着牙说道：“脱去林霄世子冠冕，剥夺林霄世子身份！贬为庶人，给我打入监牢！等候陛下发落！”
“是！”
几道身影走上来，脱掉林霄的冠冕。
“爹！不要！我没有啊……”林霄惨叫着被拖走。
叶凡一笑：“东江王大义灭亲，稍后我一定如实禀报陛下！”
“哼！”
东江王冷笑一声，阴沉的坐下去。
金銮殿内的一群王公贵族，大气都不敢喘一口，这个叶凡也太狠了，三言两语，林霄算是彻底废了。
哪怕东江王回去以后，不处理林霄，林霄日后也绝对不可能再当东江王的世子！
纳兰雪嫣的脸上完全是不敢置信的表情：“爷爷，他怎么每次看起来很嚣张，但都合情、合法、合理啊，让人挑不出一点毛病！”
“杖毙周泰是！”
“掌掴刘承恩是！”
“废了林霄也是！”

说完，纳兰雪嫣还咽了一口唾沫。
纳兰风云道：“这才是此子恐怖的地方！”
“谁说这小子是大夏第一纨绔的？我看不像！不愧是叶峥嵘的种！”
忽然。
“陛下驾到！”
刘承恩的声音响彻金銮殿！
“吾皇万岁万岁万万岁！”
金銮殿内王侯将相、王公大臣、各位皇子、公主全都起身，跪在地上恭迎！
唯独叶凡只是缓缓站起来！
朝着大夏皇帝走来的方向看去！
只见一名身穿龙袍的耄耋老者一边咳嗽，一边在刘承恩的搀扶下走出来，身后还跟着一大群人，整个金銮殿除了皇帝，就没有谁敢抬头！
唯独叶凡！
四目相对！
大夏皇帝，李甫元。
叶凡丝毫不惧，李甫元的眼底深处闪过一抹寒意，缓缓坐在龙椅上。
“平身！”
“谢陛下！”
content_en:
As soon as these words came out!
Everyone was shocked!
Even though Lin Baichuan had just sat firmly, he couldn't help but stood up with a cry: "Ye Fan, you..."
Ye Fan sneered: "Your Majesty lives eighty today!"
"A mere prince of Dongjiang Prince actually dares to question in public the Emperor of Great Xia, who personally decreed the title of Prince of Side by Side Zhenbei!"
"Don't you, the Lin family, want to rebel?"
Lin Xiao's face was extremely pale!
Lin Baichuan's old face was even more livid, and he gritted his teeth and said: "Take off the crown of Crown Prince Lin Xiao, deprive Lin Xiao of Crown Prince status! Relegate me to a commoner, and put me in prison! Wait for His Majesty's downfall!"
"Yes!"
Several figures came up and took off Lin Xiao's crown.
"Dad! No! I don't have one..." Lin Xiao screamed and was dragged away.
Ye Fan smiled: "The King of Dongjiang killed his relatives righteously, and I will report the truth to Your Majesty later!"
"Hmph!"
King Dongjiang sneered and sat down gloomily.
A group of princes and nobles in the Jinluan Palace did not dare to take a breath. This Ye Fan was too cruel. With just a few words, Lin Xiao was completely destroyed.
Even if King Dongjiang doesn't deal with Lin Xiao after he returns, Lin Xiao will never be able to be the crown prince of King Dongjiang again in the future!
Nalan Xueyan had an expression of complete disbelief on her face: "Grandpa, why does he look so arrogant every time, but he is always reasonable, legal, and reasonable? You can't find anything wrong with him!"
"Kill Zhou Tai with a stick!"
"Slap Liu Chengen!"
"The same goes for Lin Xiao!"
After saying that, Nalan Xueyan swallowed.
Nalan Fengyun said: "This is the scary thing about this kid!"
"Who said this kid is the most dandy in Daxia? I don't think so! He is indeed Ye Zhengrong's son!"
Suddenly.
"Your Majesty is here!"
Liu Chengen's voice resounded throughout the Jinluan Palace!
"Long live my emperor! Long live!"
In the Jinluan Hall, the princes, generals, ministers, princes and princesses all stood up and knelt on the ground to greet him!
Only Ye Fan just stood up slowly!
Look in the direction where the Emperor of Daxia is coming!
I saw an old man in a dragon robe coughing and walking out with the support of Liu Chengen, followed by a large group of people. Except for the emperor, no one in the entire Jinluan Palace dared to raise his head!
Only Ye Fan!
Eye to eye!
Emperor of Daxia, Li Fuyuan.
Ye Fan was not afraid at all, a chill flashed deep in Li Fuyuan's eyes, and he slowly sat on the dragon chair.
"Flat body!"
"Thank you, Your Majesty!"
